pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions are characterized by sharp pixel gradients at the boundaries and irregular polygonal geometries. Spatial area of patches is maximal on the mid-flank, becoming significantly smaller and more fragmented on the posterior limb.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-toned interstitial pathways. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial. Pixel thickness of the pathways remains consistent across the lateral torso with visible narrowing at the hindquarter transitions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck line, created by the fine texture of the mane against the sky background.
